Dear Fernway Hiring Team,

I lead cross-functional platform roadmaps end to end, most recently for a partner-facing analytics platform that grew utility-partner adoption from 12% to 65% in two years. Your Senior PM posting asks for someone who can own the fleet-software roadmap alongside hardware engineering, and cross-functional ownership is the part of the job I've spent nine years doing.

I don't yet have direct experience shipping on a hardware cadence, and I want to be upfront about that rather than talk around it. What I do bring is a track record of instrumenting a product before committing engineering time to it, and of keeping a cross-functional team aligned on what to build next.

I'd welcome a conversation about how close a fit that is for where Fernway's roadmap stands today.

Priya Nandakumar

Dear NovaGrid Hiring Team,

I lead partner-facing data platforms in businesses where the ecosystem, not any single feature, is the moat — which is the bet your Staff PM posting is making. Over the last five years I have watched the same pattern play out at two different companies: the platform that wins is the one whose partners can build on it without waiting for a roadmap slot, and the team that gets there first treats the partner surface as its own product from day one.

At Argent Grid Systems I took our partner analytics platform from 12% to 65% utility-partner adoption in two years. The turn came from instrumenting the partner funnel before writing a line of new surface, so every build decision traced back to where partners were actually stuck. That same discipline carried into the metering-data work earlier in my career at Halcyon Metering, where a redesigned intake flow cut onboarding time from eight weeks to three for over 250 utility customers.

Your posting describes the same inflection point NovaGrid is at with its own ecosystem: real usage, an unclear next layer, and a decision about whether the partner experience gets a dedicated roadmap or stays a side project. I would bring the same approach: instrument first, then build only what the data says partners are blocked on.

I would welcome the chance to talk about where NovaGrid's partner strategy stands today and where a Staff PM could move it fastest.

Priya Nandakumar
priya.nandakumar.demo@example.com · 555-0187

Priya Nandakumar
